issuerName: Controladora Vuela Compania de Aviacion, S.A.B. de C.V.

segments.name: Air transportation
segments.description: An ultra-low-cost airline providing passenger air transportation and related services in Mexico, the United States, Central America and South America.
segments.evidence: Management of Controladora monitors the Company as a single business unit that provides air transportation and related services; accordingly, it has only one operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Passengers pay low base fares for flights plus optional fees for unbundled products and services, generating passenger and non-passenger revenue.
revenueModel.evidence: We have unbundled certain components of our air travel service as part of a strategy to enable our passengers to only pay for the products and services they want to use.
